_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Imɣuren d-azwel vs Dealer

📖 AḍRIS N UḌRIS:
• Tazwara s {start_chips} ikarḍiyen
• Kuẓ n tikkelt n yikarḍiyen (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Imɣuren d-azwel vs Dealer (axxam)
• Kuẓ n tikkelt n tuneggarut tazwara: tazwara n ANTE d BLIND, tazwara n 2 ikarḍiyen, taneggarut n PLAY, taneggarut n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen, d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel. Aɣilif n imɣuren d-azwel ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel.
• Tazwara n uḍris tazwara tettaɣ imɣuren d-azwel ad yaweḍ 0 ikarḍiyen neɣ ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel.

💰 AḍRIS N YIDRIMEN:
• ANTE: Yidrimen ${ante} yal tuneggarut
• BLIND: Yidrimen ${ante} yal tuneggarut
• PLAY: Yidrimen i yellan deg uḍris n yikarḍiyen. Kuẓ n tikkelt n yidrimen i yellan: (${ante4} ɣef PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ɣef FLOP, neɣ ${ante} ɣef RIVER. Yebɣa ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel.)

🎴 AḍRIS N YIKARḌIYEN:
• Tazwara n 2 ikarḍiyen (yikarḍiyen n tazwara)
• Dealer tazwara n 2 ikarḍiyen (yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel)
• 5 ikarḍiyen n yidrimen tazwara
• Yikarḍiyen n yidrimen tazwara deg uḍris n yikarḍiyen

🏆 AḍRIS N YIDRIMEN N DEALER:
• Dealer iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel, s-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen.
• Aḍris n yidrimen n Dealer iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel.

🎮 AḍRIS N YIKARḌIYEN & TAZWARA:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Tazwara: [4x] (${ante4}) neɣ [check]
  • [4x]: Tazwara ${ante4} PLAY, tazwara n 3 ikarḍiyen n yidrimen
  • [check]: Ulac tazwara, tazwara n 3 ikarḍiyen n yidrimen

📋 FLOP:
  • ɣef 4x tazwara: [skip] i yellan (tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen)
  • ɣef ulac 4x tazwara: [2x] (${ante2}) neɣ [check]
  • [2x]: Tazwara ${ante2} PLAY, tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen
  • [check]: Ulac tazwara, tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen

📋 RIVER:
  • ɣef 4x neɣ 2x tazwara: [skip] i yellan (tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen)
  • ɣef ulac PLAY tazwara: [1x] (${ante}) neɣ [fold]
  • [1x]: Tazwara ${ante} PLAY, tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen
  • [fold]: Tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel, tazwara n yidrimen

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Yikarḍiyen n yidrimen tazwara d-azwel
  • Aḍris n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  • Yidrimen n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel

💎 AḍRIS N YIDRIMEN:
📊 ANTE:
  • Dealer ur iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel: PUSH (yidrimen tazwara)
  • Dealer iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel & imɣuren d-azwel iɣil ad yaweḍ: 1:1 payout (yidrimen + yidrimen)
  • Dealer iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel & imɣuren d-azwel ur iɣil ad yaweḍ: Yidrimen tazwara
  • Tie: PUSH (yidrimen tazwara)

📊 BLIND:
  • Ur iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  • Imɣuren d-azwel iɣil ad yaweḍ: Yidrimen tazwara d-azwel n yidrimen
  • Imɣuren d-azwel ur iɣil ad yaweḍ: Yidrimen tazwara
  • Tie: PUSH (yidrimen tazwara)

📊 BLIND PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ulac yidrimen

📊 PLAY:
  • Ur iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  • Taneggarut n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel vs Dealer
  • Imɣuren d-azwel iɣil ad yaweḍ: 1:1 payout (yidrimen + yidrimen)
  • Imɣuren d-azwel ur iɣil ad yaweḍ: Yidrimen tazwara
  • Tie: PUSH (yidrimen tazwara)

🎯 AḍRIS N YIKARḌIYEN N POKER (Aḍil d-azwel):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  2. Straight Flush: 5 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  4. Full House: 3 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel + 2 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  5. Flush: 5 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  6. Straight: 5 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  8. Two Pair: 2 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  9. One Pair: 2 ikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
  10. High Card: Aḍris n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel

⌨️  TAZWARA N YISALEN:
• [4x] neɣ [play bet 4x]: Tazwara ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] neɣ [play bet 2x]: Tazwara ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] neɣ [play bet 1x]: Tazwara ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] neɣ [c]: Check (ulac tazwara)
• [fold] neɣ [f]: Fold (tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel)
• [skip] neɣ [s]: Skip (tazwara n yikarḍiyen n yidrimen)

💡 AḍRIS N YISALEN:
• Aḍris n yikarḍiyen n tazwara iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yidrimen
• Aḍris n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yidrimen
• BLIND iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yidrimen s-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
• Aḍris n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel! ɣef 0 neɣ ad yili d-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel, imɣuren d-azwel ur iɣil ad yaweḍ.

⚠️  AḍRIS N YISALEN:
• ANTE d BLIND iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yidrimen yal tuneggarut
• PLAY iɣil ad yili d-azwel n yidrimen s-azwel n yikarḍiyen n yimɣuren d-azwel
• Aḍris n yisalen, d-azwel n yisalen i yellan.
